summary: Master social protection frameworks and community empowerment strategies. Learn to design inclusive safety nets and drive local resilience. Enroll today.
lede: Social protection and community empowerment work combines safety-net design with locally led planning to address poverty and vulnerability. For social welfare, community development, and monitoring practitioners, the course covers assessing vulnerability, designing safety-net programs, and applying participatory planning and social accountability methods to plan and monitor community programs.
audienceIntro: This intermediate-level program is essential for professionals dedicated to social welfare, community resilience, and inclusive economic growth.
modules: Foundations of Global Social Protection Systems
Digital Social Registries and Targeting Technology
Financing and Fiscal Sustainability of Social Programs
prerequisites: Participants should have at least two years of experience in social work, community development, public policy, or NGO management. Familiarity with basic socio-economic concepts and data management is recommended.
